description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade and configuration tasks for a Linux-based embedded system, specifically tailored for the Raspberry Pi's BCM27XX platform in an openwrt-like environment.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and compatibility of an image before upgrade by comparing partition layouts.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the system upgrade process, including partition updates and writing images to disk.

methods.name: bcm27xx_set_root_part
methods.description: Sets the root partition UUID in boot configuration based on a stored value.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files from backup to the device, restoring system settings.

methods.name: platform_restore_backup
methods.description: Restores system backup from a tarball.
